decisions.reason: A mitred lever handle family sits squarely within the firm's core expertise in metal door hardware, and it has stayed on the website for two years, so the firm can interpret its performance and refine it with existing know-how.
Being promoted to a page of its own in 2024 signals that management has absorbed positive early feedback, and the multifunctional handle builds directly on the firm's established handle engineering.
The door lever handle is closely related to the firm's core knowledge base and remains listed, so it is cheap to maintain and improve even though there is little visible evidence of its success.
The FSB 1289 collection won the German Design Award and the iF Design Award and keeps a dedicated page, giving the firm clear validation and strong related design knowledge to build on.
